issues.title: Z-index collision risk
issues.why: The AppShell uses hardcoded z-40 (header) and z-30 (sidebar) without referencing a central z-index scale from §07.
issues.fix: Map z-index values to §07 tokens like var(--z-index-fixed) or var(--z-index-sidebar).

issues.title: Implicit dependency on Lucide/Icons
issues.why: The responsive breakpoint section mentions 'icons only' for the collapsed sidebar but doesn't specify the icon library or sizing contract.
issues.fix: Add a cross-reference to §07 Iconography or specify a standard icon size (e.g., 1.25rem) for collapsed state.

issues.title: Scrollbar gutter shift
issues.why: The AppCanvas is 'overflow-y-auto' while the header is 'fixed inset-x-0', which can cause layout shift when scrollbars appear/disappear.
issues.fix: Add 'scrollbar-gutter: stable' to the AppShell container or main element.
